name: The Transcript
zh_summary: $GS 行政總裁：開發這些 AI 模型及基礎設施的人必須對他們所建造的東西負責，確保其運作且不會造成傷害。將這些產品嵌入企業和服務的公司必須對部署方式及其影響負責。高盛已使用 AI 類型模型進行交易平臺近 20 年，每個平臺都附有人類問責。如果我們不覺得有能力適當管理且有人類最終對任何錯誤負責，我們不會部署它。
text:
$GS CEO: "The people that are developing these [AI] models and the infrastructure that allow the technology to exist and ultimately be deployed in the economy have to take responsibility for what they're building, and that it works, and that it doesn't do harm. And then the companies that take those products and embed them in their enterprises and their service have to be responsible for the way they're deployed and the impact that they have.

"And the third is not getting as much attention, but it's equally important. Goldman Sachs has been using AI-type models for trading platforms for almost 20 years, but there's human accountability attached to every one of those platforms.

"I could never imagine someone at Goldman Sachs saying to me, "The trading platform went off and did something awful on its own. We couldn't stop it." We wouldn't deploy it if we didn't feel that we had the control to manage it appropriately, and that there was a human being that was ultimately accountable for anything that goes wrong."

name: Gary Black
zh_summary: Gary Black 討論 $AMZN（-3%）下跌的兩個主要原因：線上成長急劇放緩（同比 +2%，為 2023 年第一季以來最慢）以及資本支出高於預期（第三季 773 億美元對預期 588 億美元；2026 財年資本支出指引維持 2200 億美元）。資本支出軍備競賽在 2027 年初至中期前無法顯示有力回報是主要問題。估值方面，AMZN 在 2027 年市盈率 22.1 倍（EV/EBITDA 9.2 倍）對比 14% 長期營收成長及 +16% 每股收益成長看起來便宜。
text:
Lot of debate on $AMZN (-3%) which is down today for two main reasons:  1/ Online growth continues to decelerate sharply (+2% YoY - slowest since 2023/1Q) and 2/ Much higher than expected CapEx (3Q $77.3B vs $58.8B exp; FY 2026 CapEx guidance held at $220B). IMO, the CapEx arms race without being able to show compelling returns until early-to-mid 2027 is the main issue holding back investors from buying the $AMZN dip.

name: Shay Boloor
zh_summary: 看到 $INTC 下跌超過 30% 相當殘酷，當時數據中心收入剛增長約 80%，英特爾預期伺服器 CPU 單位在 2026 和 2027 年都增長 30% 以上。諷刺的是英特爾終於有了等待多年的需求，但由於苦苦掙扎的 PC 業務和成本高昂的製造轉型，它仍無法生產足夠的晶片來充分利用。
text:
Pretty brutal seeing $INTC down over 30% when data center revenue just grew ~80% and Intel expects server CPU units to grow 30%+ in both 2026 and 2027.

The irony is that Intel finally has demand it spent years waiting for but between its struggling PC business and costly manufacturing turnaround it still can't produce enough chips to fully capitalize on it.

name: The Transcript
zh_summary: $APO Apollo Group CEO：「已經有足夠的事件，我們最終會看到因 AI 而在世界各地發生一些重大事件，而重大事件通常會導致監管。我希望我們能提前應對，以真正深思熟慮的方式進行，而不是在當下的熱度中，但看到我們轉向某種形式的監管監督、模型保護，無論政府決定做什麼，都不會讓我感到意外。我知道這是全球各地一直在推動的事情。坦白說，這是模型本身一直在推動的。」
text: $APO Apollo Group CEO: "There have been enough incidents that we will eventually see some significant event around the world as a result of AI and typically significant events lead to regulation. I hope we get ahead of it and we do it in a really thoughtful way not in the heat of the moment but it will not surprise me to see us move to some form of regulatory oversight, protection of models, whatever it is the government decides to do. And I know that this is um something that's been pushed for around the world. It's quite frankly something that's been pushed for by the models themselves."
